description: Former Silver Falcons aerobatic team aircraft, flown as Falcon 2 and Falcon 3. Pole-mounted in the grounds of Laerskool Impala since April 1998 and still wearing the orange white and blue Silver Falcons scheme. Confirmed in place by a dated photograph of 25 September 2022 carrying Silver Falcons and Central Flying School markings. Mounted close to the boundary and photographable from the street.
